notes.en: Keep filtered water well oxygenated. Leave a calm area beside the swimming run. Leave an uninterrupted swim path for the adult group. Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows. Offer small food that reaches midwater. Provide cover around open swimming space.
notes.zh-CN: 保持过滤水体溶氧充足。 游泳区旁留有平缓水流区域。 为成鱼群体保留连续游泳空间。 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。 提供能到达中层的小颗粒食物。 在开阔游泳区周围提供遮蔽。

en.name: Neon Tetra
en.summary: A peaceful schooling fish for mature community aquariums.
en.description: Keep at least eight and plan swimming room for the adult group, not the shop-sized juveniles. Use mature, stable water and leave an open swimming run.

zh-CN.name: 霓虹灯
zh-CN.summary: 适合成熟社区缸的温和群游鱼。
zh-CN.description: 至少八尾群养，按成鱼群体而非店内幼鱼规划空间。使用成熟稳定的水体，并保留连续游泳空间。
